name: Signal
title: signal.org
shortDescription: Signal is a secure messaging app that emphasizes privacy and security with end-to-end encryption. It allows users to send text, voice messages, photos, videos, and files without SMS fees. Perfect for individuals who value privacy, it's used globally for personal chats and group communications. An example use case is a family using Signal to stay connected securely across different countries.
pros: No ads, no trackers, completely free
Open source with a focus on privacy
cons: Limited user base compared to other messengers
No revenue model which might affect sustainability
